title: Janus Engine — integrated branch checkpoint
design_thesis: Use process integration rather than isolated subsystems: extracted streams, thermal gradients and by-products should perform multiple sequential useful duties before consumption, recycle or vent. The legacy air-separation installation is treated as the reference example of this optimization principle, not as evidence of energetic self-sufficiency.

geometry_lineage.role: Geometry reference for a central rotating Axle and concentric / gyroscopic annular architecture.
geometry_lineage.boundary: The artistic/printed 3MF geometry is not a pressure-rated, cryogenic-rated or oxygen-rated engineering component without redesign and validation.

water: hydrodynamic medium around rotating gill surfaces
ultimate heat sink where a valid temperature gradient exists

rotating_gill_rings.function: High-area annular membranes interact with moving water to extract dissolved gases while rotation may thin the concentration boundary layer.
rotating_gill_rings.collection: Local cup-like collectors feed an annular manifold and then an axial gas-transfer path.
rotating_gill_rings.measurement_gate: R0 rotating-gill mass balance must pass before engine-power claims.

sequence: moisture condensation where the stream is cooled below dew point
deep drying / contaminant removal before any cryogenic stage
gas separation / purification into O2-rich, N2-rich and residual streams

water_recovery_loop.principle: Water carried with the gas stream is measured and recovered separately from dissolved-gas extraction.
water_recovery_loop.balance: m_dot_H2O_recovered = m_dot_demister + m_dot_condenser; recovery efficiency is referenced to total carried water.
water_recovery_loop.reoxygenation_boundary: Returning condensate does not automatically restore oxygen saturation; any return-water reoxygenation requires an explicit O2 mass balance.

roles: useful oxygen product / oxidizer after purity and safety gates
oxygen_branch.liquefaction_boundary: Compression alone cannot liquefy oxygen above its critical temperature; a real cryogenic refrigeration / expansion process and deep water/CO2 removal are required.
oxygen_branch.energy_gate: LOX production is blocked until oxygen mass flow and realistic liquefaction-energy budget are measured and closed.

nitrogen_branch.principle: Separated N2 is a service stream with multiple candidate duties rather than an automatic waste stream.
candidate_cascade: inert barrier / purge between oxygen-rich and hot or lubricated mechanical regions
vent or recycle only after remaining useful duties are evaluated
nitrogen_branch.thermodynamic_boundary: Nitrogen is not intrinsically cold; refrigeration requires a real temperature/pressure process and its energy cost must be counted.

three_state_annular_sorbent_block.parallel_operation: At least three phase-offset sections are evaluated so one can capture while another regenerates and another cools.
three_state_annular_sorbent_block.switching: Valves / flow routing may rotate process states without requiring every physical ring itself to rotate.

thermal_architecture.ring_condenser: Annular structure may integrate condensation / recuperation and external water heat rejection.
thermal_architecture.phase_change_loop: A closed internal working-fluid mass loop may transport engine heat, but steady-state waste heat must still leave to an external sink.
thermal_architecture.compressor_role: Compression may power refrigeration or gas-conditioning branches; oxygen-contact compressors and cryogenic oxygen service require dedicated oxygen-compatible engineering.

central_axle.role: Rotating mechanical core / rotor candidate within the concentric ring system.
central_axle.hydrodynamic_hypothesis: Rotation in water may both perform mechanical work and refresh the boundary layer around nearby exchange surfaces.

reference_architecture.legacy_installation: User-confirmed historical air-separation installation from supplied photographs; exact model name unresolved.
confirmed_by_user: installation separated air into oxygen and nitrogen
membrane / separation hardware was present behind the visible installation
the installation embodied interconnected cooling, adsorption, separation and regeneration functions
reference_architecture.lesson: The key inheritance for JANUS is not the exact legacy hardware but the harmony of mutually supporting process streams: one subsystem's by-product or temperature state becomes another subsystem's working resource.

validation_order: R0: measure rotating-gill O2 extraction versus geometry, RPM and water speed
R0B: close carried-water / condensate recovery / reoxygenation balances
R0C: measure CAPTURE -> REGENERATION -> COOLING cycle timing and N2 service duty
R0D: close O2/N2 separation and purity balances
R0E: calculate and then bench-test refrigeration / cryogenic energy floor without combustion
R1: integrate annular thermal, sorbent and gas-routing modules around a non-combustion dummy core
R2: only after all independent budgets close, evaluate a useful engine or electrochemical conversion core
next_gate: JANUS_ENGINE_R0A_GEOMETRY_FREEZE_AND_FLOW_BUDGET: freeze one Axle-derived annular test geometry and compute/measure dissolved-gas throughput, boundary-layer conditions, oxygen flux, nitrogen co-extraction, carried water, pressure drop and rotational/pumping power before any cryogenic integration.
